A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] was the '''mother''' of [[Pala Kwi'teksa]], living in a village on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] with her daughter. When the Twi'leks failed to pay the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Baron/Legends|baron]] [[Begubb]] the quota of [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]] that he demanded, Begubb took one out of every ten children from the village to sell into slavery on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
